facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition issued a call on 10 November 2026, under the World Bank-financed PADCI, for a firm to digitalise the National Barometer of Public Service Quality, with web forms, offline tablets, phone surveys and USSD/SMS collection planned, after a 2024-2025 national survey run largely by hand.
